Log Explainer

Turn raw log events into a readable sequence while keeping the factual timeline separate from AI hypotheses and refusing invented evidence.

Supported scope
Authorized Moodle log events
Design focus
Timeline first, explanation second
Built as a Moodle plugin first: permissions, native APIs and human review remain part of the workflow instead of being replaced by an external black box.
Practical results
Production-minded
✓
Native access checks
Require both plugin access and Moodle's normal report/log:view permissions in the selected context.
✓
Minimal event records
Send bounded normalized events with evidence IDs instead of arbitrary event payloads or IP addresses.
✓
Evidence validation
Reject the complete AI explanation when it cites an event ID that was not in the factual timeline.
No analysis persistence
Read logs on demand without storing prompts, analyses or model responses in plugin tables.
Group-aware visibility
Respect enrolment and separate-group visibility for selected users and activities.
Graceful AI failure
Keep the factual timeline available when routing, credits, provider calls or JSON parsing fail.
What this plugin does

Log Explainer does not ask an LLM to reconstruct what might have happened from a vague description. It first queries the Moodle log reader under the current operator's permissions and builds the timeline that actually exists.

The AI layer can summarize, organize hypotheses and identify gaps, but factual claims must cite known evidence IDs. Hypotheses must remain explicitly qualified as possibilities.

Features you get
User/course period
Inspect a user's authorized activity over a selected course period.
User/activity mode
Focus the timeline on one course module.
Event-class mode
Filter by an exact Moodle event class.
Bounded summaries
Cap event counts and explicitly mark truncated sequences.
IP redaction
Exclude stored IP fields and redact common IP literals from descriptions.
Strict JSON contract
Validate summary, timeline, hypotheses and gaps against known evidence.

Also requires AI Bridge.
